name: What steps are involved in a professional backsplash installation?

mainEntity.name: What steps are involved in a professional backsplash installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Professional backsplash installation typically involves several key steps. First, the existing wall surface is prepared and cleaned. Next, the layout is planned, and tiles are cut to fit. Then, adhesive (thin-set mortar) is applied, and tiles are carefully set. After the adhesive cures, grout is applied and cleaned. Finally, the grout is sealed for protection, and the work area is thoroughly cleaned.
acceptedAnswer.description: Steps include wall preparation, tile cutting and layout, adhesive application, tile setting, grouting, sealing, and final cleanup.
